shapeSummary: Arduino Uno-format shield: 68.6 x 53.3 x 1.6 mm PCB in the XY plane (thickness along Z, spanning Y 0..53.3) with two 3.2 mm mounting holes, two long stackable header bodies with pins protruding below, four green terminal block bodies along one short edge, and two cylindrical electrolytic capacitors. Overall Z span is about 19 mm.
warnings: Dimensions are unverified; the PCB size is assumed to be the standard Uno footprint.

The boundsMm axes were followed (Y = 53.3, Z = 19), so the PCB lies in the XY plane with its thickness along Z, even though the rules say the bottom sits at Y=0. The bottom of the part is at Y=0 as the PCB edge.
Header placement, pin counts, terminal block positions and sizes, and capacitor positions are approximate.
The mounting hole positions are estimates.
The ICs, LEDs, SMD parts, test pads and silkscreen are omitted.
cadquery:
W,H,T=68.6,53.3,1.6
yc=H/2
z0=-3.0
zt=z0+T
pcb=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z0).center(0,yc).rect(W,H).extrude(T)
pcb=pcb.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z0-1).pushPoints([(-24,yc-18),(24,yc+18)]).circle(1.6).extrude(T+2))
part=pcb
hdr_len=25.4
hx=-12
for dy in (-24.1,24.1):
    body=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=zt).center(hx,yc+dy).rect(hdr_len,2.54).extrude(9.5-zt)
    part=part.union(body)
    pts=[(hx+(i-4.5)*2.54,yc+dy) for i in range(10)]
    pins=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-9.5).pushPoints(pts).rect(0.64,0.64).extrude(z0+9.5)
    part=part.union(pins)
for i in range(4):
    tb=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=zt).center(27,yc+(i-1.5)*5.0).rect(8,5).extrude(10)
    part=part.union(tb)
for cx,cy in ((-14,yc+4),(-8,yc-4)):
    cap=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=zt).center(cx,cy).circle(3.15).extrude(7)
    part=part.union(cap)
